_about: OpenStreetMap geometry for the Montjuïc landmarks (build-montjuic-landmarks.py). Each entry: `centroid` [lat, lon] is the model origin (vertex mean of the outer ring, closing vertex dropped). ringEN_m / members[].pathEN_m / pointEN_m are metres, +X east, +Y north, relative to that entry's centroid (equirectangular, R=6378137, cos(lat) of the centroid). `ensemble` lists mapped features the model also stands in for; `context` is every mapped thing within the radius, for reference only. Data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL. Fetched 2026-09-24.
